title: PatchKV: Weight-Space Compensation of KV Cache
abstract: arXiv:2609.39329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context inference with Large Language Models (LLMs) is bottlenecked by the linearly growing memory of the key-value (KV) cache. Existing compression methods reduce the cache through token eviction or approximation, but degrade sharply at aggressive compression budgets. We propose PatchKV, a training-free framework that compensates KV cache compression methods by carrying part of the context in the model's weights. PatchKV pairs an off-the-shelf compressed KV cache with a context-specific weight patch, which is computed once at context-loading time and served for downstream queries for the context. The weight patch is derived in closed form via ridge regression, by aligning the block-wise activations of context-derived reference query tokens under the full cache and the compressed cache. Once merged into the model, the patch leaves the forward graph and per-query inference cost unchanged in the single-context, multi-query setting. Ac

translated_abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）的长上下文推理中，键值（KV）缓存线性增长的内存是主要瓶颈。现有的压缩方法通过令牌驱逐或近似来缩减缓存，但在激进的压缩预算下性能会急剧下降。我们提出PatchKV，这是一个无需训练的框架，通过将部分上下文信息承载到模型权重中来补偿KV缓存压缩方法。PatchKV将现成的压缩KV缓存与一个上下文特定的权重补丁配对，该权重补丁在上下文加载时仅计算一次，并可服务于该上下文的所有下游查询。权重补丁通过岭回归以闭式解推导得出，具体做法是对齐完整缓存与压缩缓存下、由上下文生成的参考查询令牌的逐块激活。补丁一旦合并到模型中，便不再改变前向计算图，且在单上下文、多查询的设置下每次查询的推理成本保持不变。
tldr: PatchKV是一种无需训练的框架，通过岭回归以闭式解将上下文特定的权重补丁合并进模型权重，以补偿KV缓存压缩带来的信息损失，且不增加每次查询的推理成本。
en_tdlr: PatchKV is a training-free framework that compensates for KV cache compression by merging a context-specific weight patch, derived in closed form via ridge regression, into the model's weights without increasing per-query inference cost.
